title: Article Viral Velocity
scenario: Identify articles where the page views in a single day exceeded the article's 7-day rolling average by more than 300%.
tableSchema: page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
hint: Use AVG(views_count) OVER (...) with a range frame.
correctQuery: SELECT article_id, view_date FROM (SELECT article_id, view_date, views_count, AVG(views_count) OVER(PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY view_date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) as avg_7d FROM page_views) t WHERE views_count > 3 * avg_7d;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
